meanings.note: служить в армии = to serve in the army

examples.text: А у меня все шансы есть. Жена, двое детей, не сидел, служил в армии.
examples.trans: And I've got every chance. A wife, two kids, no prison record, I served in the army.

examples.trans: But you've still got some. Give me just one.

как тебя зовут? = what's your name? меня зовут ... = my name is ...

examples.trans: Hello! How was it in Hungary?

meanings.note: short forms знаком, знакома, знакомо, знакомы (+ dative)

examples.text: А знакомо ли тебе, Аркашка, слово педикюр?
examples.trans: And are you familiar, Arkashka, with the word pedicure?

examples.text: Я услышал в коридоре знакомый голос.
examples.trans: I heard a familiar voice in the corridor.
I will call acquaintances right now.

examples.text: Аркадий Борисович, извините, тут к вам человек.
examples.trans: Arkady Borisovich, I'm sorry, there's a man here to see you.

meanings.note: in exclamations: какой грязный! = how dirty!

examples.text: Смотрите, какой у нас грязный унитаз!
examples.trans: Look, how dirty our toilet is!

meanings.en: что ли = or what, I suppose

examples.trans: I don't know whether he is at home.

meanings.note: The end of a quarrel or war.
the plural is used only in this sense
praise, said to a man, woman or child

examples.trans: I see, I see, you're a hero. Well done.

meanings.en: must, need to, it is necessary

examples.trans: We need to do even more.

meanings.en: to disgrace, to bring shame on

examples.trans: You disgraced all Russian warrant officers!
You disgraced the entire Russian army!

examples.text: Я случайно опозорил честь советского офицера.
examples.trans: I accidentally disgraced the honor of a Soviet officer.

as a side word: Правда, всё нормально = Honestly, everything's fine

examples.trans: But you were offered a job. What, is it a bad job?

examples.trans: We just didn't want to bother you. We'll cancel it all!

examples.text: Суд решил: домашний арест по месту прописки.
examples.trans: The court has decided: house arrest at his registered address.

examples.trans: Russian. Orthodox. Never been in prison.

examples.trans: Share it all equally with everyone, understand?

So I shouldn't wait for you tonight?
